title: Huge ChatGPT Update You Need to See!
lesson: The reference distinguishes question answering, developer work and longer project execution, then illustrates a morning chief-of-staff use case with multiple inputs and priority categories.
opening: Typed ChatGPT name over presenter → chat screen with red X → OpenAI identity → presentation being edited. The sequence makes a category-change claim and quickly supplies an artifact example.
story_arc: Category reversal → three app roles → connected apps and device access → chief-of-staff topology → scheduled input review → asserted morning plan and priority categories → manual/automated contrast → additional execution examples → download CTA.
payoff: Several visible work artifacts support the broad execution category. The chief-of-staff example stops at status and abstract priority labels; its actual morning plan is not revealed. Shopping, product analytics and generic desk footage sometimes lose the specific spoken example.
selection_reason: Provides a long fast sequence with role comparisons, source-input cards, real branch/output/return topology, same-scene annotation and a meaningful several-second explanatory hold. It also exposes where activity substitutes for proof.
review_limits: All six chronological 0.5s context sheets were opened through the final frame, plus four selected 6fps strips. Full-duration sampled visual coverage, not every-frame review or audio listening. Machine transcript supplies approximate speech alignment. Claims about OpenAI features, availability and counts are recorded as reference claims and not independently verified. Still strips support observed change but not exact easing. Catalog sources supply partial mechanisms, not ready replicas.
